result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, my top recommendation is **Stripe**, unless you're already using Shopify, in which case I'd choose **Shopify Payments**\.

If you're operating in Australia, there are a few particularly good options worth comparing.

## Best payment processors for a small Australian online store

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Straightforward setup
- No standard monthly processing subscription
- Credit cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay
- Excellent integrations with ecommerce platforms
- Good for growing businesses
  
  Indicative Australian domestic card fee: 1.65% + A\$0.30.
  
  [Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify
- Simple order and refund management
- Supports digital wallets
- Avoids additional Shopify third-party transaction fees
  
  Indicative Basic online domestic card fee: 1.75% + A\$0.30.
  
  [Shopify Payments Australia](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

(Best as an additional option)

- Recognisable and trusted by shoppers
- Allows customers to pay using PayPal
- Easy integration with most online stores
- Useful for international customers
  
  Indicative domestic online fee: 2.90% + A\$0.30.
  
  [PayPal Australia](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![Airwallex Logo Vector PNG | Modern Global Payments Brand Icon  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cFbGTguMuX4NolZbruyR2e9UuMWzIcApce9GwnB52sKTkNYR004hxhoF8Ij9azaRbMXEJgKRHsclL3c7QjB8TJjaOTDcrg4k3A5inD7vzblx0d1z3hgdBOQOwY04EZUWK2_K2j2_0mXQsLUCmgN2eSvYqOiDe6vtcOsjp3z8pqXOq4rreZAlQfF7YiTD92T7?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Airwallex**

- Particularly good for international sales
- Multi-currency accounts
- Competitive domestic processing fees
- Useful for businesses paying overseas suppliers
  
  Indicative domestic card fee: 1.65% + A\$0.30.
  
  [Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

Indicative fees sourced from Australian provider comparisons; actual pricing depends on card type, plan and transaction circumstances. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For a new or small online store, I'd generally start with\:

- **Stripe** for straightforward, flexible online payments.
- **PayPal** as an additional checkout option.
- **Shopify Payments** instead of Stripe if your store is built on Shopify.

You don't necessarily need multiple payment processors. One main processor plus PayPal is a good starting point.
